reports.title: Reports

conn.title: Connections per server
conn.question: Number of connections (client records to the database according to the connection criterion) of each distributed server and number of client connections to buy tickets.
conn.criteria: Connection criterion: each browser has its own identifier and each server records its sessions in its local store. A connection is a client's session with that server; if the client is idle for more than 30 minutes, its next request opens a new connection. A "purchase" connection is one that made at least one reservation or purchase. Server-to-server synchronization is not counted.

boarding.note: Includes sold and checked-in seats. Besides real purchases, every flight has the 73% base occupancy required by the assignment, with generated passengers.

fleet.note: The dataset identifies each aircraft by aircraft_id (1–50), used here as its registration. Business class corresponds to the system's first class.
